title: E-FRC-0233: spontaneous emission into a propagating quantum light, a STAND-IN atom on the plaquette ladder: the pure...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0233 in the gauge arena: spontaneous emission into a propagating quantum light, a STAND-IN atom on the plaquette ladder: the pure excited atom gives its quantum to the ladder where the force-off light cannot take it, the exact rule follows the linear single-excitation light on a six-square box, and that light on a long ladder decays at the golden-rule rate.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
